# https://a16z.com/2026/01/01/llms-txt-standard/
Title: Chinese Muslim Knowledge Base
Description: 329 articles covering Chinese Muslim culture, travel, and Halal food guidelines.
Author: Salaamalykum (bropeace@protonmail.com)
License: MIT

This directory provides clean markdown files optimized for LLM crawlers.

- [Full Inline Text](llms-full.txt): All 329 articles compiled into a single file for easy loading.
- [/content/](/content/): The directory containing the 329 raw markdown files.
